purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current viewer evidence, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official Dewas revenue-administration pages and the Government of India DILRMP report evidence local revenue/cadastral custody and digitization status. No anonymous safe parcel-ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: Dewas district's official revenue-administration pages identify Urban Dewas and Rural Dewas revenue areas and the district's tehsil/village structure. DILRMP's official Dewas district report names Dewas tehsil and reports digitized/georeferenced cadastral maps and parcel totals. This is local registry/service evidence, not proof of open geometry availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Dewas district page lists revenue divisions, tehsils, and Urban/Rural Dewas revenue villages.
Official Hindi Dewas district page gives the corresponding revenue-administration structure.
Official DILRMP page reports Dewas tehsil cadastral-map/FMB, village, and land-parcel status, including 224 georeferenced villages and parcel totals.
Official National Government Services Portal describes MP online Naksha parcel-map access by district, subdivision, tehsil, and village.
Official MP State GIS portal is publicly discoverable as a multi-layer map platform; no parcel feature schema was verified.
